title: The authz-agent schema.
description: JSON Schema for the authz-agent chart values.

ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.description: Artifact descriptor version which is installed
ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.title: The ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION schema

DEPLOYMENT_RESOURCE_NAME.description: Service name with version postfix (matching DEPLOYMENT_VERSION parameter value). Provided if facade/bluegreen mode is true
DEPLOYMENT_RESOURCE_NAME.title: The DEPLOYMENT_RESOURCE_NAME schema

DEPLOYMENT_VERSION.description: Deployment version. Provided if facade/bluegreen mode is true
DEPLOYMENT_VERSION.title: The DEPLOYMENT_VERSION schema

MONITORING_ENABLED.description: Set to true to import dashboards to Grafana and configure integration with Prometheus. Requires Platform System Monitor CRDs to be deployed to target k8s/openshift cluster
MONITORING_ENABLED.title: The MONITORING_ENABLED schema

TRACING_ENABLED.description: Enables tracing info collecting and streaming to OpenTracing- compatible collector (preferably- Jaeger)
TRACING_ENABLED.title: The TRACING_ENABLED schema

EXECUTION_MODE.description: Defines microservice execution mode in DR configuration
EXECUTION_MODE.title: The EXECUTION_MODE schema

READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.description: Read-only container file system is enabled
READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.title: The READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED schema

CERTIFICATE_BUNDLE_MD5SUM.description: MD5 sum of certificates from cloud-deployer CERTIFICATES_SECRET deploy pipeline parameter credential
CERTIFICATE_BUNDLE_MD5SUM.title: The CERTIFICATE_BUNDLE_MD5SUM schema

SSL_SECRET.description: Secret name with SSL certificates from cloud-deployer CERTIFICATES_SECRET deploy pipeline parameter credential
SSL_SECRET.title: The SSL_SECRET schema

MANAGED_BY.title: The MANAGED_BY schema
MANAGED_BY.description: The tool being used to manage the operation of an application

DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.title: The DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID schema
DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.description: Unique identifier of deployment session used to track e2e deploy activity

KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED.title: The KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED schema
KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED.description: Parameter specifies if M2M authentication with Kubernetes service account tokens is enabled

MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED.title: The MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED schema
MESH_ROUTES_ENABLED.description: Registers the check API and POST /access/v1/authorize on the platform gateways through Mesh custom resources handled by core-operator. Set to false on a cluster without core-operator, or when access-control keeps serving these routes in the same namespace

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_IMAGE.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_IMAGE schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_IMAGE.description: Overrides the authz-policy-admin image. Empty means {{ IMAGE_REPOSITORY }}/authz-policy-admin:{{ TAG }}.

IMAGE_PULL_POLICY.title: The IMAGE_PULL_POLICY schema
IMAGE_PULL_POLICY.description: Image pull policy of every container. IfNotPresent suits immutable pipeline tags; set Always where a moving tag must win on every restart

AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_FILE.title: The AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_FILE schema
AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_FILE.description: Path where the trusted-providers ConfigMap is mounted; pap-client watches this file

IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL.title: The IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL schema
IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL.description: Base URL of the platform identity provider, without a realm. Used to generate the trusted providers when AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS is empty

AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS.title: The AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS schema
AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS.description: Realms to trust when the provider list is generated from IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL. Each name becomes a provider id; cloud-common is marked required. An empty list means no providers

AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS.title: The AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS schema
AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS.description: Explicit trusted token providers, rendered into the trusted-providers ConfigMap. An entry names either an issuer, resolved through OIDC discovery, or a jwksUri, never both. Empty means the list is generated from IDENTITY_PROVIDER_URL and AUTHZ_IDP_REALMS

AUTHZ_TENANT_MANAGER_URL.title: The AUTHZ_TENANT_MANAGER_URL schema
AUTHZ_TENANT_MANAGER_URL.description: Address of tenant-manager, used to resolve a realm named by its tenant display name once discovery for that name has failed. Empty disables the lookup

AUTHZ_JWKS_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED.title: The AUTHZ_JWKS_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED schema
AUTHZ_JWKS_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED.description: true: every explicitly configured provider must be fetched before the Pod is Ready; false: one is enough. A generated provider list always behaves as false, and providers marked required must bootstrap either way

AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_TIMEOUT.title: The AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_TIMEOUT schema
AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_TIMEOUT.description: Per-request timeout in seconds for OIDC discovery and JWKS fetches

AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_RETRIES.title: The AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_RETRIES schema
AUTHZ_JWKS_HTTP_RETRIES.description: Retry count for OIDC discovery and JWKS fetches

AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_RELOAD_INTERVAL.title: The AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_RELOAD_INTERVAL schema
AUTHZ_TRUSTED_PROVIDERS_RELOAD_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between checks of the mounted trusted-providers file. 0 turns the watcher off, so provider changes need a Pod restart

AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_SOURCE_URL.title: The AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_SOURCE_URL schema
AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_SOURCE_URL.description: Base URL of the access-control service the policy pull loop reads from. Empty disables the pull, unless AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_ENABLED points the agent at the in-namespace stub

AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_PULL_INTERVAL.title: The AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_PULL_INTERVAL schema
AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_PULL_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between policy pulls. 0 disables both the pull loop and the mount watcher

AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_TOKEN_FILE.title: The AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_TOKEN_FILE schema
AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_TOKEN_FILE.description: Path of the Bearer token the pull loop sends, written by the kubelet when KUBERNETES_M2M_ENABLED is true or by the token-fetcher sidecar otherwise

AUTHZ_POLICY_CONFIGMAP.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_CONFIGMAP schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_CONFIGMAP.description: Name of an existing ConfigMap with policy data to mount instead of pulling (mount mode). Empty means pull mode. Cannot be combined with AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_ENABLED

AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_URL.title: The AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_URL schema
AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_URL.description: Base URL of the entitlements aggregator the ENTITLEMENT PIP calls. Empty leaves the resolver off, and entitlement-based policies evaluate against an empty set

AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_HTTP_TIMEOUT.title: The AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_HTTP_TIMEOUT schema
AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_HTTP_TIMEOUT.description: Per-request timeout in seconds for the entitlements aggregator call

AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_HTTP_RETRIES.title: The AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_HTTP_RETRIES schema
AUTHZ_ENTITLEMENTS_HTTP_RETRIES.description: Retry count for the entitlements aggregator call

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_ENABLED.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_ENABLED schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_ENABLED.description: Deploys the authz-policy-admin stub, which serves the v3 config API in place of access-control, and points the pull loop at it. Its control surface has no authentication: for development and test namespaces only

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_PORT.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_PORT schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_PORT.description: HTTP port of the stub: the container port, the Service port, and the port in the generated AUTHZ_PAP_CLIENT_SOURCE_URL

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DATA_DIR.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DATA_DIR schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_DATA_DIR.description: Directory where the stub keeps the uploaded policies and PIPs; it is the mount path of its volume

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_SIZE.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_SIZE schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_SIZE.description: Size of the PersistentVolumeClaim that holds the uploaded policies

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_CLASS.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_CLASS schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_CLASS.description: StorageClass of that claim. Empty uses the cluster default

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_RETAIN.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_RETAIN schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_STORAGE_RETAIN.description: Keeps the claim when the release is uninstalled or the stub is disabled

AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_PATH.title: The AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_PATH schema
AUTHZ_DECISION_LOG_PATH.description: Directory where the decision-log collector writes its NDJSON file, on ephemeral container storage

HPA_ENABLED.description: Defines whether horizontal autoscaling enabled for microservice
HPA_ENABLED.title: The HPA_ENABLED schema

HPA_MIN_REPLICAS.description: Defines the lower limit for the number of replicas to which the autoscaler can scale down
HPA_MIN_REPLICAS.title: The HPA_MIN_REPLICAS schema

HPA_MAX_REPLICAS.description: Defines the upper limit for the number of replicas to which the autoscaler can scale up. It cannot be less that HPA_MIN_REPLICAS
HPA_MAX_REPLICAS.title: The HPA_MAX_REPLICAS schema

HPA_AVG_CPU_UTILIZATION_TARGET_PERCENT.description: Target average CPU utilization for horizontal pod autoscaling
HPA_AVG_CPU_UTILIZATION_TARGET_PERCENT.title: The HPA_AVG_CPU_UTILIZATION_TARGET_PERCENT schema

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_CPU_REQUEST.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_CPU_REQUEST schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_CPU_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of CPU the authz-policy-admin container will use to start

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_CPU_LIMIT.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_CPU_LIMIT schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_CPU_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of CPU the authz-policy-admin container can use

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_MEM_REQUEST.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_MEM_REQUEST schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_MEM_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of memory the authz-policy-admin container will use to start

AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_MEM_LIMIT.title: The AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_MEM_LIMIT schema
AUTHZ_POLICY_ADMIN_MEM_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of memory the authz-policy-admin container can use

AUTHZ_AGENT_IMAGE.title: The AUTHZ_AGENT_IMAGE schema
AUTHZ_AGENT_IMAGE.description: Overrides the image of the single service. Empty composes it from IMAGE_REPOSITORY and TAG. Only used when AUTHZ_SINGLE_SERVICE_ENABLED is true.

AUTHZ_AGENT_CPU_REQUEST.title: The AUTHZ_AGENT_CPU_REQUEST schema
AUTHZ_AGENT_CPU_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of CPU the single service container will use to start

AUTHZ_AGENT_CPU_LIMIT.title: The AUTHZ_AGENT_CPU_LIMIT schema
AUTHZ_AGENT_CPU_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of CPU the single service container is allowed to use

AUTHZ_AGENT_MEM_REQUEST.title: The AUTHZ_AGENT_MEM_REQUEST schema
AUTHZ_AGENT_MEM_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of memory the single service container will use to start

AUTHZ_AGENT_MEM_LIMIT.title: The AUTHZ_AGENT_MEM_LIMIT schema
AUTHZ_AGENT_MEM_LIMIT.description: Defines maximum amount of memory the single service container is allowed to use
